timingPolicy: One warmup and three isolated trials. Retain every trial; report median and maximum, not a reliable p95 from three samples. No speed superiority claim for unmatched workloads.
observationPolicy: Synthetic development inputs only in this milestone. Freeze an independent observational protocol and resolve datum/quality before any field score. Reserved FORCE holdout and observational arrays remain unread.
convergencePolicy: Report all refinement metrics and boundary differences; do not change tolerances or hide non-monotone cases. These are numerical diagnostics, not geological field errors.
